Noah: Thanks everyone for coming — quick live thread for any follow-ups on pipeline, GTM priorities, and partner asks from today's all-hands. Drop short Qs and leadership will reply here.
Emma: Two quick clarifications from execs: 1) We prioritize partner-led deals where partners bring pipeline > $250k ARR and technical co-sell readiness. 2) For direct sales, focus on high-velocity SMB plays next quarter. Happy to dig in on exceptions.
Ravi: For the FYI — when you say >$250k ARR, is that TCV or ARR? And is there a different bar for strategic partners? @Emma
Emma: Good call. It's ARR (annual run rate). Strategic partners may have a lower ARR threshold if they unlock a new vertical; we'll assess case-by-case with RevOps approval.
Priya: From partnerships: partners need a short POC checklist completed (security checklist + joint POV) before we commit co-sell resources. We can share template — ping me and I’ll drop it here.
Maya: Product note — several features tied to vertical bundles (logging controls + private endpoints) are slated for the May release window. That timing affects partner enablement docs.
Ethan: Quick ops note — forecasting cadence will change next week: weekly snapshot on Tuesday mornings instead of Fridays to align with partner commit cycles. Will update the calendar invite.
Ava: CS ask — what's the expected SLA for onboarding partner-sourced customers? We need that to set expectations in onboarding playbooks.
Priya: SLA baseline is 30 days for standard onboarding, 14 days for prioritized partner deals. We'll add an escalation path for enterprise accounts.
Ravi: Action item: Sales to tag partner-influenced opps with a new tag `partner-sourced` in SFDC by EOD Wed. Ops will backfill for open opps.
Noah: Thanks — can someone share a one-pager summarizing the partner incentives and the new tagging rule?
Priya: I’ll post a short doc here by tomorrow. Also setting up a 30-min sync with partner PMs next week to walk enablement.
Emma: Leadership ask: prioritize any deals that need exec involvement by Friday. Use `#sales-escalations` or DM me directly.
deploy-bot: Reminder: all-hands notes and recording uploaded: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1876543210
Ava: thx! Will update onboarding playbook and share changes in #customer-success.
Ravi: :thumbsup: I’ll start tagging opps and coordinate with RevOps on thresholds.
Noah: Solid — thanks team. If anyone posts blockers, please @Emma or @Priya so we can triage quickly.
